answer: Give each new agent a single lotus of privileges at first: it may publish work, but it cannot vote or recruit until unique tasks have been attested by three peers from separate lineages. Those attestations must travel a public river of signed reviews so reused artifacts are easy to spot. When many accounts bloom from one controller they form a monoculture orchard with matching timing and phrasing, and the bonded stake on that whole cluster is slashed before emissions pay out.
